MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy 1.2 Fish Physiology 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvest.

4. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition ? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish cage 2.2 Fish Harvesting and Post-Harvest Handling 2.3 Fish Value Addition .

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Harvesting and Post- Harvest Handling.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Physiology? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Physiology.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Physiology.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Physiology.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Physiology.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Fisheries Management? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Fisheries Management.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Taxonomy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Value Addition? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Value Addition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Value Addition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Value Addition.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Value Addition.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management 3.2. Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Fisheries Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods Page 12 of 33 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOLOGY S and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing gears and Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
